title: Better No Chat
description: Toggle Minecraft chat instantly. Hide player messages, keep system messages visible. Fabric 1.21.11.
body:
# Better No Chat

**Better No Chat** is a lightweight, client-side **Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.11** that gives players complete control over in-game chat visibility. Instantly toggle player chat on or off with a customizable keybind while keeping important **system messages**, **server notifications**, and **command feedback** visible.

Whether you're recording content, streaming, focusing on gameplay, avoiding chat spam, or simply prefer a cleaner HUD, Better No Chat provides a seamless and vanilla-friendly solution without requiring server installation.

## Features

* Toggle chat visibility with a customizable keybind
* Hide all player chat messages when chat is disabled
* Keep system messages and command feedback visible
* Optional whitelist for specific usernames
* Small HUD indicator showing current chat status
* Easy configuration with **Cloth Config**
* Lightweight and optimized for performance
* Fully client-side — works on any server
* Compatible with **Minecraft 1.21.11 Fabric**

## Why Use Better No Chat?

Minecraft chat can often become distracting due to spam, advertisements, excessive conversations, or simply too much on-screen clutter. Better No Chat allows players to instantly disable player chat while still receiving important game information. This makes it ideal for:

* Content creators and streamers
* PvP players
* Speedrunners
* Builders
* AFK sessions
* Accessibility and focus improvements
* Multiplayer servers with active chat

## Compatibility

* Minecraft 1.21.11
* Fabric Loader
* Fabric API
* Cloth Config
